notes: Boosters and the board. Three named boosters with money and a cause (facilities, the rival, local kids, defense, offense, loyalty) sit on the Program tab with a mood that moves with every result and every season; take one to dinner, ask for NIL money, and keep them off the AD's phone. Home-field edge now depends on your fan approval.
